local Title = "Teleport GUI"

gui.Parent = game.CoreGui

Frame.Parent = gui

Frame.Selectable = true

Username.Parent = Frame

Username.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 33)
Username.Position = UDim2.new(0, 19, 0.25, 0)

	local pl = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
	local pl2 = Username.Text
	local humanoid = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid
	humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
	wait(0.1)
	pl.CFrame = game.Players[pl2].Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
end)

TeleporttoPlayerUICorner.Parent = TeleporttoPlayer
TeleporttoPlayerUICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

UsernameUICorner.Parent = Username
